problem.summary: AFL++ native typed stage was hard-coded to 16 operations, while the GPAC_3403 compact HEVC/VPS-extension mutation operators live at op32-op35.
problem.impact: Prior native long runs could not exercise the compact GPAC_3403 operators even when the BindingSpec selected hevc_annexb_structure_hook.py. Extra time alone would not test the intended repair.

fix.runtime: FORMTRIG_TYPED_OPS is now read by afl-fuzz-one.c with a default of 16 and a hard max of 4096.
fix.runner: scripts/run_formtrig_aflpp_campaign.sh accepts --typed-ops N and exports FORMTRIG_TYPED_OPS.
fix.manifest: scripts/run_formtrig_native_manifest.sh accepts typed_ops: N and forwards it to the campaign runner.
